description: This Java source file defines the ResourceHelper class, which provides utility methods for handling Android resource files, including resource name extraction, resource type checks, color and drawable resolution, and resource URL generation within the Android Studio environment.

classes.name: ResourceHelper
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for Android resource file handling, including resource name extraction, resource type checks, color and drawable resolution, and resource URL generation.

methods.name: isProjectStyle
methods.description: Checks if a style string represents a project-defined theme style.

methods.name: styleToTheme
methods.description: Converts a style resource string to a user-visible theme name.

methods.name: isValueBasedResourceType
methods.description: Determines if a resource type can be defined in any file within the 'values' folder.

methods.name: getResourceName
methods.description: Extracts the resource name from a VirtualFile or PsiFile.

methods.name: getResourceUrl
methods.description: Generates the resource URL string for a given resource file.

methods.name: isFileBasedResourceType
methods.description: Checks if a resource type is stored in a dedicated file named after the resource.

methods.name: getFolderType
methods.description: Determines the resource folder type for a given PsiFile or VirtualFile.

methods.name: getFolderConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the folder configuration for a given PsiFile or VirtualFile.

methods.name: getResourceVariations
methods.description: Returns all resource variations (e.g., different qualifiers) for a given resource file.

methods.name: viewNeedsPackage
methods.description: Determines if a view with a given fully qualified class name needs its package included in layout XML.

methods.name: resolveColor
methods.description: Resolves a resource value to an RGB Color, following references and parsing color files if necessary.

methods.name: findInStateList
methods.description: Finds a color attribute in a list of XML nodes that does not have an associated state.

methods.name: parseColor
methods.description: Converts a color string in formats like #rgb, #argb, #rrggbb, #aarrggbb to a Color object.

methods.name: resolveDrawable
methods.description: Resolves a resource value to a drawable file, following references and parsing XML if needed.

methods.name: resolveLayout
methods.description: Resolves a resource value to a layout file.

methods.name: prependResourcePrefix
methods.description: Prepends a project-specific resource prefix to a resource name if configured.
